inventory.name: [NopalCyber] Malicious DLL Execution - Export Function Call

native_rule.creator: bhanu.nandanampati@nopalcyber.com
native_rule.name: [NopalCyber] Malicious DLL Execution - Export Function Call
native_rule.s1ql:
"(
  tgt.process.cmdline EndsWith '.dll,StartW'
  OR tgt.process.cmdline EndsWith '.dll StartW'
  OR tgt.process.cmdline EndsWith '.dll,DllRegisterServer'
  OR tgt.process.cmdline EndsWith '.dll DllRegisterServer'
  OR tgt.process.cmdline EndsWith '.dll,DllUnRegisterServer'
  OR tgt.process.cmdline EndsWith '.dll DllUnRegisterServer'
  OR tgt.process.cmdline EndsWith '.dll,DllInstall'
  OR tgt.process.cmdline EndsWith '.dll DllInstall'
)
AND src.process.parent.image.path Does Not ContainCIS 'McAfee'
AND src.process.commandLine Does Not ContainCIS '\McAfee'
AND NOT
(
  tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase 'fcagiep'
  OR tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase 'fcploff'
  OR tgt.process.cmdline contains:anycase 'fcplou'
)"
